title: Hybrid resolver: prefer curated ONLY when it actually answers, else retrieval, with provenance
priority_note: The core of #305/#306 AND its biggest risk: a curated answer that is near-but-wrong, labeled :curated, is a confidently-wrong answer that is now trusted — strictly worse than the RAG failure this epic exists to prevent. Depends on the governed curated rule (31.1).

background.reference: GitHub issues #305/#306; hub 820602df (the refund-policy hallucination). Reuses Loopctl.Knowledge.search_combined/3 (the Elixir function; 'knowledge_search' is the MCP tool/route name) and its meta (fallback/search_mode/keyword_only).
background.includes: US-31.1 defines governed curated sources. This story adds hybrid_search that returns a curated answer ONLY when a curated source clears an absolute threshold, beats the best retrieved candidate by a margin, and is not conflicted/superseded; otherwise it returns retrieval — every response flagged with provenance.

story.as_a: an agent querying the knowledge layer
story.i_want_to: call one hybrid function that returns a curated answer only when a curated source genuinely answers the query (flagged :curated) and retrieval otherwise (flagged :retrieved), with confidence and meta
story.so_that: I get a trustworthy curated answer when one exists and never a near-but-wrong curated doc mislabeled authoritative

rationale: The harvested failure is a confident answer from an unrelated chunk. The naive fix ('prefer any curated doc') recreates that failure with a worse label: a curated doc semantically near a query it does not answer, returned as authoritative. Requiring the curated candidate to clear an absolute threshold AND beat retrieval by a margin AND be conflict-free is what makes ':curated' actually trustworthy.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.Knowledge.hybrid_search(tenant_id, query_string, opts \\ []) returns {:ok, %{results, meta}} where meta carries provenance (:curated | :retrieved) + confidence, folded into the existing search_combined meta. It returns :curated ONLY when a governed curated source (US-31.1) matches above an absolute curated-confidence threshold (config).

Curated-must-actually-answer: a curated candidate wins ONLY when it clears the absolute threshold AND its score beats the best retrieved candidate by a configurable margin AND it is not superseded / not in an open potential_conflict. A curated doc that is semantically near but below threshold, or not competitive, falls to :retrieved (no false :curated claim). AC-31.2.1 and this AC together are the single, non-contradictory resolution rule.

The :curated and :retrieved responses share the SAME shape/keys (results + meta{provenance, confidence, search_mode, fallback, ...}) so a caller reads one shape and branches on the provenance FIELD, never on which subsystem answered — the literal form of #305's 'no caller-side RAG-or-curated branching'.

Degradation honesty (SOUL rule 7): when embeddings are unavailable, curated matching uses the keyword path; if a curated source is still confidently identifiable by keyword it is returned :curated, otherwise the response is :retrieved with meta.fallback/search_mode reflecting keyword_only — never a silent empty and never a false :curated under degraded matching.

Provenance outcome (curated vs retrieved, hit/miss) is emitted into the existing retrieval metrics (Loopctl.Knowledge.RetrievalMetrics / retrieval_metric_snapshot), so 'prefer-curated silently hiding better retrieval' is observable per tenant.

Tenant isolation: hybrid_search threads tenant_id into BOTH search_combined AND the curated lookup via AdminRepo/HeavyRead (RLS does NOT backstop these BYPASSRLS reads); a two-tenant test proves no cross-tenant answer.

test_cases.name: curated that answers wins; near-but-wrong curated does NOT
preconditions: a governed curated article answering 'refund policy'
a DIFFERENT governed curated article semantically near 'refund' but about shipping refunds process (does not answer the policy query)
embedding stubbed deterministic so the near-but-wrong doc scores high but below the answering doc/threshold
steps: hybrid_search(tenant.id, "<query the near-but-wrong doc is only loosely related to>")
expected_results: first: the answering curated article, provenance: :curated
second: falls to :retrieved (the near-but-wrong curated doc is NOT returned as :curated)

test_cases.name: curated and retrieved responses share the same shape
preconditions: a curated response and a retrieved response from hybrid_search
expected_results: identical key sets; both carry provenance + confidence + search_mode — caller branches only on provenance

test_cases.name: long-tail query falls back to retrieval, flagged
preconditions: tenant with only non-curated articles matching a niche query

test_cases.name: threshold/margin resolution is a testable pure decision
preconditions: a curated score, a best-retrieved score, threshold + margin config
steps: evaluate the resolution rule for: above-threshold+beats-margin; above-threshold+within-margin; below-threshold
expected_results: :curated only in the first; :retrieved in the other two

test_cases.name: degraded embeddings: honest meta, no false curated
preconditions: EmbeddingCircuitBreaker open; a governed curated article present
expected_results: meta reflects keyword_only/fallback; curated returned only if keyword-confident, else :retrieved; never a silent empty

technical_notes: Function: Loopctl.Knowledge.hybrid_search/3 = (tenant_id, query_string, opts) -> {:ok, %{results, meta}}, matching the module convention (search_combined/3, search_keyword/3). There is NO scope-struct or map-query convention in the knowledge context — do not invent one.

Reuse Loopctl.Knowledge.search_combined/3 (knowledge.ex ~5656) for retrieval + its meta (fallback/search_mode/keyword_only). 'knowledge_search' is the MCP tool / GET /api/v1/knowledge/search route, NOT an Elixir function.

Resolution rule (single, non-contradictory): :curated iff curated_score >= absolute_threshold AND curated_score - best_retrieved_score >= margin AND source not superseded/not in open potential_conflict; else :retrieved. Thresholds are config.
Tenant: thread tenant_id via AdminRepo/HeavyRead; RLS does not backstop (knowledge.ex header BYPASSRLS caveat).
Tests: pure resolution/predicate cases are unit; DB-backed cases are integration; Mox embedding stub.
